title: QuickDistance
description: Adds keybinds for quickly increasing and decreasing your render distance.
body:
# QuickDistance

QuickDistance is a Fabric client-side Minecraft mod that adds keybinds for quickly increasing or decreasing your render distance.

## Features

- Increase render distance with the right arrow key.
- Decrease render distance with the left arrow key.
- On-screen message showing the current render distance.
- Works with mods that extend Minecraft's render-distance option range.
